events.verdict: Bitadze (ORL) lowers his hand and initiates contact with Davis's (LAL) elbow, affecting his shot attempt.
Da Silva (ORL) grazes James's (LAL) arm during his shot attempt near the rim.
Christie (LAL) moves laterally into Suggs (ORL) path, initiating leg contact that causes him to lose his balance.
Isaac (ORL) and Suggs (ORL) reach in and the contact with Reaves' (LAL) arm is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Isaac (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Isaac (ORL) jumps from point A to point B and initiates contact with James' (LAL) body, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Suggs (ORL) and Reaves (LAL) come together during the rebound and the contact is marginal. Reaves is not dislodged from his position as a result of any illegal contact by Suggs.
Suggs (ORL) jumps into Davis's (LAL) body, affecting his ability to control the rebound.
Bitadze (ORL) establishes himself in Reddish's (LAL) path and does not deliver contact.
Davis (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Wagner's (ORL) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Wagner (ORL) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
Reddish (LAL) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Isaac (ORL) legally contests Davis's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
